integrity: The whole-size formula is proved analytically from a four-leaf generating-function identity and an exact root-grafting difference; the checker is a finite independent exact-arithmetic consistency check, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous independent taxon extinction; unit edge lengths, rooted nonplane full-binary shape and half-initial-PD threshold only.
The crossover formula applies to the specified grafted tree pair, not every tree pair or empirical phylogeny.
General distribution algorithms are prior literature; historical priority of the sharp threshold remains subject to independent review.
title: The sharp five-taxon boundary for mean-versus-half-retention phylogenetic risk
